calling.query: Query parameters are strings. A POST JSON object wins when the same key is on the query string. Invalid JSON is ignored and the query stands.
calling.conditionTools: get_sunrise_sunset, get_weather_forecast, get_water_temperature, get_lunar_cycle, get_tide_predictions, get_sea_conditions, get_uv_index, and get_weather_alerts return HTTP 200. A tool failure is HTTP 200 with ok false, error, and message. It is not an empty success.
calling.speciesGuideTools: list_species, list_guide_topics, search_species_guides, and get_chapter return the tool result status. Success is 200. A bad request is 400. A missing chapter or species is 404. A downstream failure is 502.
calling.hostFailure: A thrown host failure is HTTP 500 with ok false.

tools.name: list_species
tools.instruction: Returns the published species list. No inputs. Does not return chapter text.
tools.success: ok true and the published species names and slugs.
errors: The HTTP status follows the tool result: 200 on success, 400 for a bad request, 404 when the chapter or species is missing, 502 when the downstream call fails.

tools.name: list_guide_topics
tools.instruction: Returns the published topic keys. No inputs. Does not return chapter text.
tools.success: ok true and the published topic keys.
errors: The HTTP status follows the tool result: 200 on success, 400 for a bad request, 404 when the chapter or species is missing, 502 when the downstream call fails.

tools.name: search_species_guides
tools.instruction: Returns how-to and species facts from one published book. Required species is a published common name or slug. Put the question in query. topic is an optional published topic key. top is 1, 2, or 3 and defaults to 3. Does not return live water or weather, and does not return regulations.

inputs.name: species
inputs.rule: Published common name or slug. One species per call.

inputs.name: query
inputs.rule: Question about that species. Optional.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.rule: Published topic key. Optional.

inputs.name: top
inputs.rule: 1, 2, or 3. Default 3.

tools.success: ok true and the matching chapter bodies.
errors: The HTTP status follows the tool result: 200 on success, 400 for a bad request, 404 when the chapter or species is missing, 502 when the downstream call fails.

tools.name: get_chapter
tools.instruction: Returns one published chapter. Pass id, or pass species and topic. Does not search.

inputs.name: id
inputs.rule: Chapter id. Example: haddock-time-temperature. Required when species and topic are omitted.

inputs.name: species
inputs.rule: Published common name or slug. Required with topic when id is omitted.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.rule: Published topic key. Required with species when id is omitted.

tools.success: ok true and one chapter body.
errors: The HTTP status follows the tool result: 200 on success, 400 for a bad request, 404 when the chapter or species is missing, 502 when the downstream call fails.

tools.name: get_sunrise_sunset
tools.instruction: Returns sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, civil twilight, and solar noon for a place and date. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. date is yyyy-MM-dd and defaults to today's UTC date. timeZone is an optional IANA or Windows id. This is not weather and not water temperature.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: date
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Default is today's UTC date.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.rule: Optional IANA or Windows time zone id. Example: America/New_York.

tools.success: ok true, the resolved location, and the solar times.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.instruction: Returns an hourly air weather forecast: temperature, rain, wind, humidity, sky cover, and conditions. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. hours is 24, 48, or 72. days is 1, 3, or 7. Do not send both. Omit both for 24 hours. This is a forecast, not a current observation.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: hours
inputs.rule: 24, 48, or 72. Do not send with days. Default 24 when both are omitted.

inputs.name: days
inputs.rule: 1, 3, or 7. Do not send with hours.

tools.success: ok true, hoursRequested, hoursReturned, and the forecast hours.

tools.name: get_water_temperature
tools.instruction: Returns observed water temperature: the current reading and hourly history for trend. Days is lookback, not a forecast. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. nearest is 1, 3, or 5 and defaults to 1. days is 1, 3, 7, 30, or 90 and defaults to 1. maxDistanceMiles is 10, 25, or 50 and defaults to 25. This route returns JSON only and does not stream a chart image.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: nearest
inputs.rule: 1, 3, or 5. Default 1.

inputs.name: days
inputs.rule: 1, 3, 7, 30, or 90. Default 1. Lookback, not a forecast.

inputs.name: maxDistanceMiles
inputs.rule: 10, 25, or 50. Default 25.

tools.success: ok true and the observed readings for the stations in range.
tools.emptySuccess: no_station_within_range is a successful empty result.

tools.name: get_lunar_cycle
tools.instruction: Returns the lunar almanac for a place and local date range. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. Pass date, or startDate and endDate. Omit the date for today. The range is inclusive and at most 31 days. Do not send a time zone. This is not a tide prediction.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: date
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Omit for today. Do not send with startDate or endDate.

inputs.name: startDate
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Inclusive. Required with endDate when date is omitted.

inputs.name: endDate
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Inclusive. At most 31 days from startDate.

tools.success: ok true, the resolved location, and days of lunar phase and illumination.

tools.name: get_tide_predictions
tools.instruction: Returns predicted high and low turns for a place and date range. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. Pass start and end as yyyy-MM-dd, or omit both for today. Inclusive, at most 31 days. Do not send a time zone. nearest is 1, 3, or 5 and defaults to 1. maxDistanceMiles is 10, 25, or 50 and defaults to 25. Heights are predicted above Mean Lower Low Water, in feet and meters. type H is a high tide. type L is a low tide. This is not an observed water level and not a continuous curve.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: start
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Omit with end for today.

inputs.name: end
inputs.rule: yyyy-MM-dd. Inclusive. At most 31 days from start.

inputs.name: nearest
inputs.rule: 1, 3, or 5. Default 1.

inputs.name: maxDistanceMiles
inputs.rule: 10, 25, or 50. Default 25.

tools.success: ok true and predicted high and low events with local and UTC times.
tools.emptySuccess: no_station_within_range and no_predictions_in_window are successful empty results.

tools.name: get_sea_conditions
tools.instruction: Returns observed sea conditions at the nearest reporting stations: significant wave height, dominant and average period, wave direction, sustained wind, gust, barometric pressure, and station air temperature. Recent history, not a forecast. Pass place, or latitude and longitude. nearest is 1, 3, or 5 and defaults to 3. days is trailing UTC hours and is 1, 3, 7, 45, or 90. Default 1. days is not a date range and not a forecast. maxDistanceMiles is 10, 25, or 50 and defaults to 50.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: Place name. Required when latitude and longitude are omitted.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.rule: -90 to 90. Required with longitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.rule: -180 to 180. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

inputs.name: nearest
inputs.rule: 1, 3, or 5. Default 3.

inputs.name: days
inputs.rule: 1, 3, 7, 45, or 90. Default 1. Trailing UTC hours.

inputs.name: maxDistanceMiles
inputs.rule: 10, 25, or 50. Default 50.

tools.success: ok true and station observations. sensors says which of wave height, wave direction, wind, and pressure that station reports.
tools.emptySuccess: no_station_within_range and no_readings_in_window are successful empty results.

tools.name: get_uv_index
tools.instruction: Returns the current EPA UV Index issuance for a US place or five-digit ZIP. Hourly values and the daily index are the issuance published now. No date is accepted and no later day is available. Pass place or zip. Latitude and longitude are not accepted.

inputs.name: place
inputs.rule: US place name. Required when zip is omitted.

inputs.name: zip
inputs.rule: Five-digit US ZIP. Required when place is omitted.

tools.success: ok true and the current EPA issuance, including the outdoor scale.
tools.emptySuccess: A place with no ZIP, or an issuance with no forecast, is a structured error, not an invented index.

tools.name: get_weather_alerts
tools.instruction: Returns National Weather Service watches, warnings, and advisories active at the moment of the call. Snapshot, not a forecast and not a history. Latitude and longitude are both required. Each alert includes event, severity, urgency, certainty, response, headline, description, instruction, area description, effective, expires, and ends. expires is when the message expires. ends is when the hazard ends, when it was sent. Relay instruction when present. When instruction is empty, relay description. Do not invent safety guidance.
tools.success: ok true and the active Actual alerts for that point, sorted by severity then expires.
tools.emptySuccess: An empty alerts array means no active alert contains that point, including points outside National Weather Service coverage. An empty array is not a failed call.

notOnHttp.name: server_health
notOnHttp.reason: MCP only. Host smoke test is GET /api/health and is not this tool.
